description: CO bond order from the bond-selection LP active set. Computes per-shared-pair marginal binding via the reduced (2k+2)-strand covalent channel, solves max sum_k k*y_k s.t. 0<=y_k<=max(m_k,0), and reports |active_set| as the predicted bond order. Probe of the 'SDP active-set = bond order' hypothesis. Zero fitted parameters.

orthogonal_channel_model.caveat: equal-channel approx overbinds energy (3x sigma vs D0_CO); cap=3 is dim(R^3) [non-circular], per-molecule value is valence-informed [confirms structure, not ab-initio].

data.finding: Interleaved (2k+2)-chain gives active_set=1: only sigma binds; the pi pairs anti-bind (ee-repulsion accumulates in one chain). 'Bond order = active-set cardinality' holds for ORTHOGONAL orbital channels (sigma _|_ pi_x _|_ pi_y), each an independent ~H2-like channel — NOT a single growing chain. co-lp-dual-binding.md's one-chain decreasing-marginal mechanism needs correction (WS-F/WS-B follow-up).
